component.name: Local Save Switcher
component.summary: Multiple playthroughs for your PC games

description.p: Keep several playthroughs of the same PC game: pick the one you want, LSS loads its saves and starts the game. Today it works with Steam games that keep their saves in Steam's userdata folder; other launchers are planned.
